title: The Omnipresence of God
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The omnipresence of God means that God is fully present everywhere. No place is beyond His sight, rule, knowledge, or nearness.
summary: The omnipresence of God means that God is fully present everywhere. No place is beyond His sight, rule, knowledge, or nearness.
christFocus: Jesus Christ promises His people that He is with them always. Through Christ and by the Spirit, believers are never abandoned, unseen, or outside the presence of God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God is not limited to one location. Heaven and earth cannot contain Him. He is near and far, present everywhere, and fully aware of all that exists.

God’s omnipresence is not the same as saying God is creation. God is distinct from what He has made, yet He is present to all of it. Every creature lives before Him and depends on Him.

This doctrine can comfort or confront. For the believer, God’s presence means there is no valley, wilderness, hospital room, prison, grief, or hidden place where God cannot be near. For the sinner, there is no darkness where sin can be hidden from Him.

Christ’s promise to be with His people gives the doctrine pastoral warmth. The God who fills heaven and earth is not distant from the disciple who follows Jesus in weakness and obedience.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people feel forgotten, especially in suffering, disability, isolation, rejection, or long seasons of waiting. The omnipresence of God says that no place of pain is beyond His nearness.

This doctrine also calls people to reverence. Nothing is done outside God’s presence. Every act of worship, obedience, temptation, secrecy, or suffering is lived before Him.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Practice the presence of God with reverence and comfort. Do not believe the lie that you are alone, unseen, or unreachable. Cry out to Him where you are, resist hidden sin, and follow Christ knowing He is with His people always.
